---
title: "Headings that open with a figure"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: report
---

A section that is a heading and its chart, and then a new page. Under XeLaTeX
an author's `\newpage` left the figures still waiting at the top of the new
page, the section's chart no longer fitted under its heading, and the heading
sat alone at the foot. Under Typst a floating figure is not in the flow, and
its heading had nothing to go over with. Every heading here must share its
page with its chart.
